diagnostics.message: The literal `res://.godot/animal-behaviours-preview.png` does not exist on disk (no file and no directory). Nothing here proves it is loaded, so this is a warning — but a `res://` string in a script is almost always a path that is about to be opened, and the load will return null.
diagnostics.suggested_fix: Create `res://.godot/animal-behaviours-preview.png`, fix the path, or — if the file is produced at runtime — write it through `FileAccess.open(…, FileAccess.WRITE)` / `ResourceSaver.save()`, which the linter recognises and stops reporting. `# lint:ignore res_path` on the line silences it for good.
